sources.observation: Current table labels military/administrative ranks and linked badge graphics; text supplies no cylinder regulation. Saved older MHTML and current chart represent different revisions.

Proposes wearer-left then right then left then right for totals 1–4; describes access permits and rank differentiation. This is the author’s analytical rule, not an Imperial Republic regulation. Describes silver pen-like devices and an uncommon concentric-shell form.
Uses its own explicit canon model and rejects cylinders as rank insignia; conflicts with Saxton on interpretation. Do not merge either interpretation into a universal law.

Costume standard permits 1–4 devices; optional level-two specifies wearer-left for a single device. Blue-topped dosimeter and other styles are listed; higher costume certification requires a film-referenced combination. These costume rules do not establish a complete per-rank ladder.
